meaning:
Lod = "travail"
a city approx 11 miles (17 km) southeast of Joppa in the plain of Sharon in the territory of Benjamin
Also named: Ludda (Λύδδα "Lydda" G3069)

elsewhere.note: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.
The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.
